propositions: review_interrupts metric is published dimensionless and masks the reason field (bound-exceeded vs signal-unavailable), preventing CloudWatch sweeps from distinguishing routine drain saturation from broken health probes
autodeploy.sh already stamps AUTODEPLOY_REVIEW_INTERRUPT markers with a reason field, but observability.sh discards it when counting into review_interrupts
split review_interrupts into two separate dimensionless metrics (review_interrupts_bound_exceeded and review_interrupts_signal_unavailable) by filtering the journal on reason field patterns

replace the single rolled-up review_interrupts alarm with two reason-scoped alarms (rebar-autodeploy-review-interrupts-bound-exceeded and rebar-autodeploy-review-interrupts-signal-unavailable), each carrying only its own remediation

keep the rolled-up review_interrupts metric published (unalarmed) for history and future reasons, and retain signal-unavailable's single-datapoint latching (evaluation_periods=1, datapoints_to_alarm=1)
terraform apply must be executed in infra/terraform to activate the new alarms on the live account
